english.title: Fail to collect or transport WEEE in a way that optimised reuse and recycling

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 90(9) and 91(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a person who collected or transported WEEE
in connection with the carrying out of an obligation under regulation 28 or 29 of the regulations
failed to ensure that all such WEEE was collected or transported
in a way that optimised reuse and recycling of that equipment or of components of that equipment
